title: Earth's Mightiest Heroes
intro: [excited] Avengers, assemble! Welcome to Disney Jeopardy, where tonight we suit up for Marvel, from the big screen to Avengers Campus. Grab your shield, charge your arc reactor, and please... no snapping.

art.prompt: A gleaming futuristic hero headquarters tower on a hill at sunrise, a sleek jet silhouette taking off and streaks of colorful energy in the sky, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

categories.title: Snap Judgments
categories.intro: We start with the Infinity Saga, the big story of the MCU. [chuckles] I am inevitable... and so are these questions.

art.prompt: Six glowing colored gemstones floating in a cosmic swirl of purple and gold space dust, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Thor's mighty hammer goes by this name.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Mjolnir! Only the worthy can lift it. [laughs] Sorry, Tony.

clues.clue: Thanos hunts down all six of these to complete his gauntlet.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Infinity Stones! Space, Mind, Reality, Power, Time and Soul. Collect them all... but please don't.

clues.clue: The Marvel Cinematic Universe began in 2008 with this film starring Robert Downey Jr.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Iron Man! [chuckles] 'I am Iron Man' was improvised, and it changed movies forever.

clues.clue: In Avengers: Endgame, the heroes pull off their time heist by traveling through this tiny dimension.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Quantum Realm! [laughs] Scott Lang got stuck there for five years and it felt like five hours.

clues.clue: Thanos learns the Soul Stone is hidden on this desolate planet, guarded by the Red Skull.
clues.reveal: [sighs] The correct answer is Vormir. A soul for a soul. Still not over it.

categories.title: Secret Identities
categories.intro: Every hero has a secret. Give me the superhero name for each real name. [whispers] Don't tell anyone.

art.prompt: A city rooftop at night with a coat rack holding a cape, a mask and a hero suit hanging under a starry sky, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Peter Parker swings around Queens as this hero.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Spider-Man! Your friendly neighborhood one, of course.

clues.clue: Scientist Bruce Banner turns into this big green guy when he gets angry.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Hulk! [chuckles] That's my secret, Cap. I'm always angry.

clues.clue: T'Challa, king of Wakanda, is better known as this hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Black Panther! Wakanda forever!

clues.clue: Hope van Dyne, daughter of Hank Pym, fights alongside Ant-Man as this winged hero.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Wasp! She got her name in the title of Ant-Man and the Wasp, and her own wings.

clues.clue: Pietro Maximoff, Wanda's twin brother, is this speedy hero in Avengers: Age of Ultron.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Quicksilver! [gasps] You didn't see that coming? Neither did he.

categories.title: Hero Gear
categories.intro: Picture category! Each image shows a famous piece of hero gear. Tell me which character it belongs to.

clues.clue: Whose gear is this?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Captain America! That shield is made of vibranium, and he throws it like a frisbee.

clues.clue: Whose gear is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Iron Man! That glowing arc reactor kept Tony's heart going. Proof that Tony Stark has a heart.

clues.clue: Whose gear is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Thanos! The Infinity Gauntlet. [whispers] Please keep your fingers apart.

media.prompt: A huge golden armored glove with six empty gem slots on the knuckles, lying on a stone pedestal in a cosmic temple, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Whose gear is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Doctor Strange! The Eye of Agamotto held the Time Stone. [chuckles] Dormammu, I've come to bargain.

media.prompt: A round golden amulet with an eye-shaped clasp hanging over a flowing red cloak draped on a stand in a mystical library, original painterly illustration, no text, no logos, no people, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: Whose gear is this?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Loki! Those golden horns are pure mischief. [laughs] Even his helmet is dramatic.

categories.title: Campus Life
categories.intro: To the parks! These are real photos from Marvel in the Disney parks. [excited] Recruits, report for duty.

art.prompt: A bustling modern hero training campus plaza with sleek buildings, banners and a jet perched on a rooftop under a blue sky, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: At Pym Test Kitchen, seen here, food comes supersized or shrunk thanks to this tiny hero's Pym Particles.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Ant-Man! Try the Quantum Pretzel. It's enormous. [laughs] Science!

clues.clue: This sleek Avengers aircraft perches on top of Avengers Headquarters at Disney California Adventure. Name the jet type.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Quinjet! The Avengers' ride of choice. Parking up there must be a nightmare.

clues.clue: The Iron Man Experience, the first Marvel ride at any Disney park, opened in 2017 at this resort.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hong Kong Disneyland! Tony Stark flies you over the real Hong Kong skyline. [excited] Very cool.

clues.clue: This Quinjet sits at Avengers Campus in Disneyland Paris, where Flight Force pairs riders with Iron Man and which hero?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Captain Marvel! Avengers Assemble: Flight Force opened in 2022 on the old Aerosmith coaster track. Higher, further, faster!

clues.clue: Before Avengers Campus opened in 2021, this part of Disney California Adventure was home to this Pixar-themed kids' land.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is a bug's land! It closed in 2018 so the Avengers could move in. [chuckles] Turns out heroes squash bugs.

categories.title: Marvel-ous Facts
categories.intro: Our fan category: behind-the-scenes Marvel facts for the true believers. Excelsior!

art.prompt: A cozy comic book shop at night with racks of colorful comics, a glowing neon star in the window, no readable text, original painterly animated-film style artwork, wide 16:9 composition, no text, no logos, no recognizable copyrighted characters.

clues.clue: This Marvel legend made cameos in many MCU films before he passed away in 2018.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Stan Lee! Excelsior! His cameos were a treasure hunt in every film.

clues.clue: Disney bought Marvel Entertainment in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 2009! About four billion dollars. [laughs] Pretty good deal in hindsight.

clues.clue: Loki gets arrested by this time-policing agency, known as the TVA, in his Disney Plus series.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Time Variance Authority! For all time. Always. [chuckles] And Miss Minutes keeps it cheerful.

clues.clue: This 2014 Oscar winner was the first Walt Disney Animation film based on a Marvel comic.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Big Hero 6! Baymax is technically a Marvel hero. [laughs] Fist bump. Ba-la-la-la.

clues.clue: In 2008's Iron Man, Tony Stark is kidnapped by a terrorist group with this name.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Ten Rings! Fans waited 13 years before Shang-Chi revealed their leader. Talk about a long setup.
